title: Observability-first Onboarding: Modular Screens + Annotated Traceflows
creator: Asha Patel
body:
Goal: Produce a compact, modular set of onboarding visuals and product screenshots for the Observability Quickstart that demonstrate latency distributions, cost-per-token breakdowns, and a new annotated traceflow view. These assets will be used in the Quickstart guide, in-app onboarding carousel, docs landing page, and the marketing feature preview.

Design scope:
- 8 final screenshots: 3 desktop dashboard variants (compact/per-route, expanded/top-50 latency, cost-breakdown by model), 2 traceflow-focused screens (collapsed and expanded annotations), 2 mobile-responsive thumbnails, 1 animated GIF showcasing trace expansion (for docs).
- Annotated callouts for each screenshot (primary learning objective + suggested copy).
- Separate low-bandwidth / high-contrast variants for accessibility and email previews.
- Figma deliverables: componentized screenshot templates so PM/Engineering can update numbers without re-exporting full comps.

Key decisions / trade-offs made: 
- Chose to display percentile latency (p50/p95/p99) instead of mean for clearer SLO signal; trade-off: slightly more copy for first-time users.
- Cost visualization uses cost-per-token with per-model toggles; decision favors transparency over minimal UI because customers repeatedly asked for per-model economics during interviews.
- Traceflow annotations are layered: top layer highlights span duration and cache hits, secondary layer explains fallbacks and model variants. This keeps the visual dense but scannable.

Acceptance criteria:
- All screenshots exported at 1440x900 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile) with annotated callouts attached as separate SVG overlays.
- Copy approved by PM and Product Marketing.
- Figma file contains tokens for color/spacing and a README with export sizes and naming conventions.
- Engineering acceptance: overlays can be toggled in the Console tutorial flow via CSS classes.

Deliverables (filenames and short descriptions):
- obs_onboard_compact_per_route_v1.png - compact dashboard, per-route latency and small sparklines.
- obs_onboard_expanded_latency_v1.png - expanded latency heatmap and percentile ribbons.
- obs_onboard_cost_by_model_v1.png - cost-per-token bar+line hybrid with model selector highlighted.
- obs_traceflow_collapsed_v1.png - single request trace, collapsed view showing endpoint and duration.
- obs_traceflow_expanded_v1.png - expanded trace with annotations for KV cache hits, kernel switch, and fallback.
- obs_mobile_thumb_latencycost_v1.png - mobile thumbnail combining latency and cost.
- obs_high_contrast_latency_v1.png - accessibility variant.
- obs_traceflow_expand_animation_v1.gif - short loop showing trace expand + callouts.

Review notes and links: 
- Figma master file: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/Redwood-Observability-Onboarding (comment thread: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/#comment-121)
- PR for tutorial overlay CSS: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4783
- Confluence design spec (copy + acceptance): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/OBS-Quickstart+Design+Spec

Open questions: 
- Do we need localized copies for JP/EU launches in the first release? PM suggests EN-only for v1, but Sales flagged EU partners.
- Should cost-per-token include amortized infra for Dedicated customers (requires data from billing team)? Marked dependency on ENG-4120.

Next steps / timeline: 
- 2025-09-15: Deliver draft screenshots to PM and ENG for feedback (done).
- 2025-09-16: Iterate on trace annotations after Eng feedback (kernel-level labels simplified) (done).
- 2025-09-18: Finalize assets, export variants, and attach to PR for tutorial UI (this ticket).

Notes for engineering handoff: include SVG callout layers separate from background PNG so Console can animate callouts individually. Provide CSS class naming conventions in Figma README.
comments: 2025-09-13 - Miguel Santos (ENG): Reviewed expanded latency heatmap. Requested that p99 be visually separated with a thin red ribbon to make SLA breaches obvious. Action: DES to add ribbon and provide alt text.

2025-09-14 - Priya Rao (PM): Copy update: replace 'cost per token' header with 'Estimated cost / token' to align with billing copy. Also asked for a short tooltip text. Action: DES to add tooltip sentence and hand to content writer.

2025-09-15 - Clara Nguyen (DES): Uploaded first pass of 3 desktop screens. Left notes in Figma on layers to be exported as SVG overlays. Added accessibility variant for high contrast per accessibility audit.

2025-09-16 - Eng Trace Team (ENG): Confirmed trace annotation labels: KV cache hit (green), kernel swap (amber), fallback to smaller model (red). Confirmed durations are captured by runtime instrumentation under ENG-4012.
2025-09-17 - Asha Patel (DES creator): Updated GIF timing per review: increased expand duration to 600ms for legibility. Added README entries for export naming conventions.
2025-09-18 - Clara Nguyen (DES assignee): Final exports attached to PR #4783. Pending PM final approval for copy.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 assets exported in specified resolutions
Figma file has tokenized colors and README
PM approval on copy and labels
Engineering can toggle SVG overlays via CSS classes
qa_checks: Contrast ratio >= 4.5 for body text on all variants
GIF loop plays under 2s and is <500KB
Export filenames match naming convention in README
risks: Billing data for per-model amortized cost may delay final cost chart
Trace annotation density could overwhelm novice users—may require progressive disclosure
follow_up_tasks: ENG-4120: surface amortized cost data to UI
PM-860: finalize tooltip text for cost metric
